task.description: WF-03 step 7, TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR, gate pass 1 of 3, the regression tests of the fix of ISS-0092 (REQ-110; run ISS-0092-20261117-01). Gate as WF-02 step 5b, and for a defect also: the new tests FAIL on the product before the fix and PASS after it. You cannot run the tests on this PC (decisions/0110), so prove everything with your own read-only scripts in your own folder and put what only GitHub can prove into result.must_be_proved_on_github. Do, in this order: (1) Read the whole test change (git diff HEAD -- tools/test and the new file tools/test/node-floor.test.js) and the designer's result. (2) Coverage table: every criterion of REQ-110 (and the numbered parts of the design section 10) → the test that goes red when it is violated; every entry point E1 to E11 of the design section 3 has a row; the hook rules of section 4; the single source of the floor and the equality (section 5); CI-3 and CI-8 (6.3, 6.4); anything without a test is a finding. (3) Soundness and independence: own oracles (a test does not import the rule it tests, except where the design makes the guard module the subject: say which test does and judge it); no dependence on the clock or the order; each test has its own data; no real home folder and no port 4780, 4781, 4782 or 4790; no secret; a test of a child process cannot hang the run (a timeout is set). (4) Mutants: apply at least 25 mutants of your OWN (not only the designer's 76) to copies of the product or of the rule functions, evaluated by your own independent harness (say what you reused); include: the floor constant changed in each of its places one at a time; the guard missing in each entry point one at a time; the guard placed after the dispatch; the version compare using string order or ignoring the patch part; a pre-release or an empty version accepted; engines text edited in the package file and in the lock root separately; check-latest removed, false, moved to another step; the hook accepting a version text with a shell metacharacter; the hook keeping a candidate's stderr; a candidate in a folder with a space; the header count changed. A surviving mutant is a finding unless proved equivalent. Prove the working tree is unchanged by your mutants (hashes before and after). (5) Defect rule: show which of the new tests are red on the product before the fix (a copy of the tree with the fix files at the state of the tag base/ISS-0092-20261117-01 and the new tests) and which stay green on purpose and why. (6) Nothing weakened: print the number of test( registrations and assert. occurrences of each changed file at the tag and now (not lower except where the replacement table says a row is replaced by stronger ones); no skip, todo or only. (7) The harness you rely on (a collector that replaces the node:test import): is it faithful for these tests; name what it cannot show. (8) Format and lint: run `npx prettier --check` and `npx eslint --max-warnings 0` on the four changed files in a fresh clone of the project in your own folder (core.autocrlf=false, npm ci; they do not run the tests) and print the output. (9) Verdict PASS or FAIL with findings by severity; any item not passed is FAIL. Be economical: one script that applies all mutants and prints a table. RULES OF THIS PC (decisions/0110, 0127, 0129): do NOT run npm run check, cd app && npm run ..., node --test, the tools test scripts or the e2e tests; the record of a test run is read from GitHub with gh run view (read-only). Allowed: cd tools && npm run -s traces and handoffs-check; read-only git and gh; your own scripts and fresh clones (git clone -c core.autocrlf=false, npm ci) only in your own folder under <scratch>. Node 22 first on PATH (<node22>). A server you start binds port 0 or a free high port and is stopped by its exact process id; never bind, probe or stop the ports 4780, 4781, 4782 and 4790. One browser at a time on this PC. No git commit, push, pull, checkout, stash, reset or tag. LF line endings. Never write the name of the reference product, nor a path of this computer, into a Sai file or a handoff (write <scratch> or <outside the project>). Fill only the result of your handoff; the top-level status stays PENDING and completed_at null: ORCH closes. English.
